specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: Two of the diesel engines are 1396 cc units, one with 75 PS (55 kW; 74 hp) and 220 N⋅m (160 lb⋅ft) and the other a 90 PS (66 kW; 89 hp) and 220 N⋅m (160 lb⋅ft) high power unit.

specs.name: torque
specs.source_sentence: Two of the diesel engines are 1396 cc units, one with 75 PS (55 kW; 74 hp) and 220 N⋅m (160 lb⋅ft) and the other a 90 PS (66 kW; 89 hp) and 220 N⋅m (160 lb⋅ft) high power unit.

specs.name: engine_cc
specs.source_sentence: Four are petrol, including the 1248 cc dohc 16 valve "Aditeya" engine, while the rest are diesel engines.

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: All diesel engines and 1.2-litre and 1.4-litre petrol engines come mated to five speed manual transmission, there is an option of a four speed automatic for some 1.4-litre petrol engined models, the 1.6-litre is mated to a six speed manual transmission.

specs.name: mileage
specs.source_sentence: Hyundai claims that the 115 PS (85 kW; 113 hp) diesel unit can return a class leading 115g/km of CO2 per litre of diesel to go 23.25 km/L (65.7 mpg‑imp; 54.7 mpg‑US) (4.3L/100 km) in the European combined driving cycle.

specs.name: top_speed
specs.source_sentence: As the i20 N only weighs 1,190 kg (2,620 lb), it is able to accelerate from 0–100 km/h (0–62 mph) in a 6.2 seconds with a top speed of 230 km/h (143 mph).

specs.name: price
specs.source_sentence: In Australia, the i20 was originally offered as a 1.4 petrol with a $3500 option of the Gamma II G4FC 1.6 petrol engine.
